changelog:
brand-kit v1.0.0

- Initial release of an end-to-end enterprise brand visual asset generation skill.
- Covers the full pipeline: demand analysis, design generation (SVG/Logo suite), format conversion (SVG→PNG/ICO), integrated HTML handover, brand guidelines, and extended applications.
- Generates a complete brand asset set: 87 files (2 HTML, 33 SVG, 51 PNG, 1 ICO) across 6 domains and 25 task types.
- Provides automated multi-size rendering, format conversion, batch processing, and consistency checks.
- Includes robust downgrade mode for consultation and planning when dependencies (Edge/Pillow) are unavailable.
- All processes, file structures, and outputs are strictly specification-driven for compliance, consistency, and completeness.
summary: 企业品牌视觉资产端到端生成。能力：①需求分析（BA1）②设计生成（BA2，Logo+形态派生+SVG批量+信息注入+小尺寸优化）③格式转换（BA3，SVG→PNG+ICO+校验）④整合交付（BA4，HTML+完整性+清理）⑤品牌规范与扩展应用（BA5-BA6，可选）。全量87个文件（2 HTML + 33 SVG + 51 PNG + 1 ICO）。33 SVG = 3核心标志 + 18 VI系统 + 3品牌规范 + 9扩展应用。6域25种任务。触发词：生成品牌资产、VI系统、Logo套件、商标稿件、名片信封信纸、favicon全套、brand asset、meta-skill-system。
